text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna do my best dancing with 
Ojo!! Pleeeaaaseee, I'm beggin' yaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the Bal Droit is a once-a-year 
occasion, after all. Let's do our best to 
make it a wonderful dance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the dance studio, Daitaku 
Helios was learning how to dance from 
Mejiro Ardan for the Droit ball, but—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: One, two, th—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Nheeek!!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ms. Helios!? Are you all right...!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bwah! I'm fine! Tripping over my own feet, 
lol.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, nothing's working out at all~. Is it 
'cause my lady-vibes are lacking??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was secretly worrying like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I can see a burning love in you— A love 
so dazzling it's blinding."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: âRamo-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you make no effort to show it. 
Could the reason... be something else?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: !!!! ...That's sooooo true!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be wuv, right?! My wuv for the 
young lady comes first! Why'd I even 
forget that?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but how am I s'posed to show my 
lovey-dovey side? ...Ardan-sensee-!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about we switch the style 
from Standard to Latin?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Latin?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When expressing love—passion— Latin 
music conveys it much more directly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's listen to the music. Just 
surrender yourself to the rhythm—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Boom-clap, boom-clap, boom-clap, 
boom-clap—)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fooooooooooooo~~~!!!! Oh man, this gets me 
so hype~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Reach her, reach her, go get 'er~~~~!! 
Pour all my wuv straight into Milady's 
heart~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... Wha?! Ramo-sen?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, so terribly unpolished...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not bad. —Your love has 
reached me.”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
!! Sheeey-ah!! Got the stamp of approval 
from Senior!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching too, Trainy-P!? My best 
moments☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like this'll work out well!

Yeah, this looks like it'll work out 
great!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching too, Trainy-P!? My best 
moments☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like this'll work out well!

Yeah, this looks like it'll work out 
great!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I was watching too, Helios! Those 
steps were full of life!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's Tap-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my dance soul is totally 
on fire now! Mind if I join in and dance 
with you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaayyy! Let's tear it up, yeah! Dancing 
niiightâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios and Tap Dance City dancing. 
Mejiro Ardan and Mejiro Ramonu smiling. 
The place was engulfed in an extraordinary 
frenzy—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That is so it! Like, my passion won't 
stop! I'm gonna go invite the lady right 
now☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Found you!! Miladyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Guess what, I learned 'Latin'! I wanna 
dance with you right now, Milady! Whaddya 
think!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I'm terribly sorry, but I have a dinner 
engagement scheduled after this.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Salt! *sob*!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I rushed over out of concern, well... 
things were unfolding exactly as expected.
